mentions.name: Gran Turismo 3 bike-power mod
mentions.description: A planned integration that would connect an open-source Gran Turismo 3 'recomp' running on a laptop to a Zwift smart-bike ride, so the rider's pedal power output drives the car's horsepower (exploring 1 watt = 1 hp). Current fitness would be enough to win early career races, and improved fitness would eventually keep pace with faster cars like a base model WRX.
mentions.source_excerpt: There’s an open source “recomp” of Gran Turismo 3 that supposedly works pretty well on a laptop.  I kinda want to hook it up so that the Zwift ride provides the power output for the car.
